FAQ

What counts as a ton?

The tons of rebar in your final accepted takeoff, added up across all seats on your account each month. Re-running a revised drawing of the same project within 30 days doesn't count against your tons.

What happens if I go over my monthly tons?

You keep working. Extra tons are billed at your plan's overage rate.

Do I need AutoCAD?

No. SetTime works on its own. No AutoCAD license needed.

What drawing formats do you support?

Vector PDF is supported today. Tell us what you work with, and we'll let you know what fits.

Can SetTime connect to our own systems?

API integration isn't a self-serve feature yet, but we can build a custom integration for your workflow. Contact us to talk it through.

Can I add more seats?

Yes. On Team and Business, extra seats are US$249 per seat per month.

Can I switch plans or billing?

Yes. You can move between plans and between monthly and yearly billing.

How does billing work?

Payments are processed securely by Paddle, our reseller. Prices exclude applicable taxes, which are calculated at checkout. Taiwan prices exclude the 5% business tax, which is added on top.

Is my drawing data safe?

Your drawings are used to produce your takeoff. See our Privacy Policy for details.
